reason: My accountant keeps telling me to cut costs, and 560 rupees for 1,000 credits with a free test first is small enough to try for the 12.12 sale next to my current provider. I would not move my whole list over yet, only one campaign to compare.
objection: A proper Sinhala sale message is more than 70 characters, so each one will eat 2 or 3 credits. That means 1,000 credits is really about 400 messages, and I am not sure that is any cheaper than what I pay now. Getting a new sender name approved is also a hassle when the old one already works.
would_change_my_mind: If my first campaign shows the per-customer cost is clearly lower than my current provider for the same Sinhala message, with similar delivery, I would move my whole list and buy the bigger package.
